name: Council of AI — list_cards
description: The published signed-card index (https://councilof.ai/signed/card_index.json): what the index declares (n_cards) and how many rows it actually carries, reported next to — never reconciled with — the count the card store endpoint (https://councilof.ai/api/cards) reports for itself. Two labelled numbers from two surfaces; if they disagree, this tool shows the disagreement rather than picking one. Optional filters return recent rows: axis, limit.
interface_note: list_cards is served by MCP tools/call at POST https://councilof.ai/mcp. It is not a skill of the A2A door at https://councilof.ai/api/a2a; that door's skills are the ones listed on https://councilof.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json. This card is generated by scripts/a2a-tool-cards.mjs from the manifests the door serves.

axis.description: Only list rows whose axis matches this name (case-insensitive).

limit.description: How many rows to include in the listing (newest first). Default 10. The two counts are always reported in full regardless of this limit.
